description: Require sign-in at an App's Telbase URL (every plan): an emailed code (onetimepin), Google, Microsoft or GitHub; only allowed emails and email domains get in. Also removes entries, sets how long a sign-in lasts, signs every visitor out, or turns sign-in off. Returns the resulting configuration.

domains.description: Email domains to allow in, such as acme.com.

off.description: Turn sign-in off: the App is public at its Telbase URL. Takes no other option.

session_length.description: How long a sign-in lasts, in hours, such as 24h (the default) or 168h.

sign_in.description: onetimepin (an emailed code; the default for a new protection), google, microsoft, or github.

name: protect_app
